onboarding.description: The revolutionary app that teaches you how to box using your phone's camera.
onboarding.cameraPermission: We need camera access to track your punches

jab.name: Jab
jab.description: A quick, straight punch with your lead hand. Fast and precise.
jab.instruction: Extend your lead arm straight forward, rotating your fist to land with knuckles. Snap it back quickly.

cross.name: Cross
cross.description: A powerful straight punch with your rear hand. Uses body rotation for power.
cross.instruction: Rotate your hips and shoulders as you extend your rear arm straight forward. Full body power.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description: A circular punch thrown with a bent arm, targeting the side of the head or body.
hook.instruction: Bend your elbow 90 degrees, swing horizontally with hip rotation. Lead with your elbow, not your fist.

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.description: An upward punch aimed at the chin or solar plexus. Great for close range.
uppercut.instruction: Bend your knees, then drive upward with your rear hand, rotating your body. Like a shovel motion.
